page_title: LEN 2-0 MNT | Lens v Montpellier 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' The foul by Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mathieu Vernice.
90+1' 2 - 0 It's an own goal! Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) scores into his own net!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Yellow card! It's like Brice Samba (Lens) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Mathieu Vernice agrees and books him.
87' Lens quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

86' What a great touch by Anass Zaroury (Lens)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
85' A quickly taken corner by Montpellier.
84' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to make a change. Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) replaces Jordan Ferri.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabriel Bares (Montpellier) is coming onto the pitch as Joris Chotard cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' The goal by Lens won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
83' Wait! Referee Mathieu Vernice has indicated he is going to review the Lens goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
83' Wesley Said (Lens) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
81' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Facundo Medina.
79' Florian Sotoca (Lens) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Mathieu Vernice didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
79' Facundo Medina (Lens) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight and sees a foul from Florian Sotoca (Lens). Montpellier are awarded a free kick.
76' Will Still prepares a substitution. Angelo Fulgini is replaced by David Pereira da Costa (Lens).
76' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

75' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the roof of the net that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. Montpellier will take a corner kick.
75' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.

74' Florian Sotoca (Lens) runs onto a ball from Angelo Fulgini and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nikola Maksimovic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Akor Adams (Montpellier).
71' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) sees a yellow card from Mathieu Vernice after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
71' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Brice Samba is alert and denies him.
70' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
68' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mathieu Vernice saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to Montpellier.
68' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:3.
63' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Lens.
61' Will Still decides to make a substitution. M'Bala Nzola will be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Florian Sotoca (Lens) coming on for Remy Labeau Lascary.
60' It's time for a substitution. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) comes on in place of Andy Diouf.
59' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.

59' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Benjamin Lecomte. The referee points to the corner flag and Lens will take a corner.
59' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
57' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
57' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
51' Andy Diouf (Lens) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process. It's a free kick to Montpellier in a dangerous position.
50' Montpellier players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' Jean-Louis Gasset makes a half-time substitution. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) comes on in place of Arnaud Nordin.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The game is interrupted now, Nikola Maksimovic (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
44' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Mathieu Vernice lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
42' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Facundo Medina (Lens). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
42' Anass Zaroury (Lens) commits a foul and Mathieu Vernice immediately signals a free kick.
39' 1 - 0 Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
38' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
37' PENALTY APPEAL after Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

35' Poor effort! The corner picks out Kevin Danso (Lens) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
34' Anass Zaroury (Lens) will take a corner kick.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anass Zaroury (Lens).
30' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul. Montpellier will take a free kick.
27' Great touch by Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
23' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
13' A cross into the box finds the head of M'Bala Nzola (Lens) who steers it goalwards, but Benjamin Lecomte manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
13' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

13' Facundo Medina (Lens) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Lens win a corner.
11' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

6' Facundo Medina (Lens) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
4' Lens work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

4' Facundo Medina (Lens) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

1' Andy Diouf (Lens) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Montpellier, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lens will have the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice will supervise the game today.
